author: Harijks

title: Less friction. More action.
body:
So far my experience using this app is satisfying. It doesn’t have the gimmicks that most habit tracker apps have. It is simple. It works.

Will give another in depth review once I use it for more than a month, see where this app goes with my habit tracking.
author: aldrin.navarro

title: Awful tag on new version
body: Why the tags show all goals even when it’s not due today. It is more organize to show only due goal on each goals. I like to restart a habit and start a new date

title: The app just doesn’t work
body: I re-downloaded it multiple times but the App opens to a frozen page.
author: Will_Jared

title: Simple app to use!
body: User-friendly! Nice reminders! You can keep track of every habit you want to make. Remember that the sub-conscious mind learns from developing a habit so be vigilant and choose wisely what habits you want to make.
author: Glacial the Gamer

title: Helps me to keep on track!
author: lizel_tan

title: I love it!
body: I love it how there is no limit, and i can easily log my habits. It is simple, yet it is very useful!
author: Gaybe Mejia

title: So far so good
body: Still into my 2nd day of using the app. It got me to drinking water regularly. Also set a target savings goal for ten years and it shows how much i must save every month to accomplish it

title: Useful
body: Works well in tracking progress towards goals

title: Great app

title: Great App but...
body: So far this app is very efficient and funtionality-wise it is working well but I'm not able to archive anymore nor add a comment in a task.

title: A great habit tracker
body: I use this app as a way to track my progress with the habits I want to build. It shows you stats that can help motivate you each day and help measure how much you had accomplish.
